question: Where can I get a list of solar PV projects currently in permitting in Spain, with location, capacity (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: Spain publishes regional project information and official notices, but the sources checked do not establish a complete current national list. Catalonia, Aragon, Valencia and Navarre provide regional project data. The ministry describes a state map as under construction; BOE notices provide dated milestones. National coverage and current-stage dates remain unverified.
main_caveats: State and autonomous authorities process different projects; the 50 MW threshold has territorial exceptions.
A public notice records an event, not necessarily the present status; check subsequent decisions.
Navarre includes projects with AAP and/or AAC; its BEGINLIFE field is a database insertion date.
Panel MWp and nominal installed MW are different; regional sources use different fields.
GEM has coarse project statuses, size thresholds and a download request form; individual Spanish records were not tested.
answer.confidence_reason: Regional files and a BOE notice were tested; the state map service and national coverage remain unchecked.

how_to_use.example_result: PSFV Galera Solar; 47.16 MW; Castelldans; Galera Solar, SL; En tramitació; Informació Pública (DOGC).
steps: Filter estat for En tramitació; paginate to retrieve all records.
Check whether multiple rows refer to one project before counting.
Aragon: curl -sSL --max-time 40 'https://opendata.aragon.es/GA_OD_Core/download?resource_id=321&formato=csv'; the first project is CASTOR (Hibridación), HABIDITE ENERGY SL, 17 MWp.

Valencian WFS sample: https://terramapas.icv.gva.es/2601_Fotovoltaicas?service=WFS&version=2.0.0&request=GetFeature&typeNames=ms%3ATramitacion.Vallado.GVA&count=2&srsName=urn%3Aogc%3Adef%3Acrs%3AEPSG%3A%3A4326; first feature HISOPO NUCIA 1, 4.89 MW, HISOPO POWER SL, Admitida a trámite.
Navarre: download the ZIP and open ENERGI_Pol_PSolarTra.shp in EPSG:25830; first row LA PEDRERA, RIOS RENOVABLES, 1 MW, 5146-CE.
reading_traps: The administrative and environmental statuses are distinct. Date of status was not established in the sample.
Aragon has different files for admission, prior authorisation and construction authorisation; do not equate peak MWp with installed AC MW.
Navarre BEGINLIFE is the SITNA insertion date, not the permit-stage date.
Navarre publisher specifies AAP/AAC, unlike the broader description in datos.gob.es.
Aragon GeoJSON has projected coordinates but no declared CRS; conversion using EPSG:25830 was plausible for two named sites and all 88 first vertices in a broad bounding box.
Some members give polygons, while Catalonia sample only gives municipality; geometry does not establish current legal status.
